# 社区行为准则 / Code of Conduct

[简体中文](#简体中文) · [English](#english)

## 简体中文

在 Issue、PR、评审和讨论中保持尊重。善意理解他人，提出可执行的反馈，照顾不同经验水平的参与者。不接受骚扰、威胁、人身攻击、歧视、垃圾内容或公开他人隐私。即使是举例，也不要发布私人 Agent 会话或密钥。

违反准则时，维护者可以编辑或移除有害内容、关闭讨论或限制参与。遇到 GitHub 上的不当内容，可使用其 **Report content** 菜单；如果有选项，可向仓库管理员或 GitHub Support 举报。操作说明见 [GitHub 文档](https://docs.github.com/en/communities/maintaining-your-safety-on-github/reporting-abuse-or-spam)。安全漏洞请使用[私密报告入口](SECURITY.md)。

## English

Be respectful in issues, pull requests, reviews, and discussions. Assume good intent, give actionable feedback, and make room for different experience levels. Harassment, threats, personal attacks, discrimination, spam, and sharing another person's private information are not welcome. Do not post private agent sessions or secrets, even as an example.

Maintainers may edit or remove harmful content, close conversations, or restrict participation when these standards are violated. Report problematic GitHub content using its **Report content** menu; where offered, choose a report to repository admins or GitHub Support. See [GitHub's reporting instructions](https://docs.github.com/en/communities/maintaining-your-safety-on-github/reporting-abuse-or-spam). For a security vulnerability, use [private vulnerability reporting](SECURITY.en.md) instead.
